'''November 2000 Dartmouth tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at GrandMaster Games and Hobbies, Dartmouth, MA on 25 November 2000. [[Rich Hinds]] won it. It is known from Michael Pistone's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1497">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-26-dartmouth-ma-11-25-00d1497/ dartmouth-ma-11-25-00], DeckTech (Michael "MadSkills84" Pistone, 26 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-26-dartmouth-ma-11-25-00d1497/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 25 November 2000
* '''Site:''' GrandMaster Games and Hobbies, Dartmouth, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Rich Hinds]]
